coverage.scope: Complete classification of every current BLOCKED_BY edge; scoped principal probabilistic roadmap, explicit Vs30 gates, selected hazard and legacy domain dependencies. Not a final exhaustive dependency registry for all 160 issues. Historical references, tracker children, and overlapping work are not automatically hard edges.
coverage.unresolved: See unresolved and issue-review-coverage.json; source bodies/comments are the original audit snapshot, not a fresh live GitHub read.

type_semantics.implementation_prerequisite: Required artifact/interface before the named implementation or integration can run; co-implementation allowed if ordered within one accepted package.
type_semantics.release_evidence: Required correctness/validation evidence before the named product/claim is released; does not block independent prototype work.
type_semantics.optional_fidelity: Optional branch/fidelity tier; promote to explicit required evidence only after scope selection and diagnostic justification.
type_semantics.external_input: Specific data, provenance, compute or benchmark evidence; ready only when verified available.
type_semantics.human_decision: Explicit recorded scope/hold release/selection decision; no automatic promotion or timeout inference.

scheduler_requirements: Resolve readiness by accepted versioned artifact/criterion and current hold, not merely open/closed issue state.
Refresh holds, dependencies, decisions, PR status and head SHA between batches and before each issue dispatch.
Reject missing endpoints, unrecognized types, hard epic blockers and implementation cycles; report all exclusion reasons.
Scope each dispatched work package to one or more dependent node IDs.
Keep issue closure separate from sub-deliverable acceptance; close only when all approved required scope is evidenced.
Optional edges do not block other scopes; selected optional branch obtains explicit activation evidence.
A human-decision label/registry pause remains binding even if an implementation prerequisite is accepted.
Record sources and approval SHA/version for decisions and acceptance; replace proposal input IDs with concrete manifests before execution.
